nom: Dr.Melaxin Cyano Pink Spicule Serum with Vitamin B12

segments.mature: The one reviewer who names her skin as mature, in her 60s, reports good results and counts herself a repeat fan of the brand, though without specifying which effect improved.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report visibly smoother, tighter-looking skin, smaller-looking pores and softer fine lines within days to a couple of weeks of use, including one who noticed a difference after a single application and one in her 60s who calls it one of her favorites.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as lightweight and hydrating, leaving skin smoother, plumper or glowing, though a couple note it isn't very moisturizing on its own and works better paired with a separate moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Reports vary widely: most reviewers feel only a brief, non-painful tingling from the spicules with no visible redness, but a few describe real irritation, including one reviewer without generally sensitive skin who still reacted, and another who broke out in hives across her face and neck for five days.
concerns.barrier: One detailed reviewer reports that daily use of the tingling serum eventually damaged her skin barrier, causing burning and flaking and making her react to other products she previously tolerated, after which she switched to occasional, exfoliator-like use instead of daily application.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer who addresses this reports noticing less discoloration alongside smoother-looking skin after her very first use; no other reviewer comments specifically on spots or discoloration.

aspects.libelle: Distinct tingling, prickly spicule sensation on application
Should be tapped or pressed in, not rubbed, to avoid irritation
Distinctive pink color from the formula itself
Small bottle, but a little goes a long way
Pricey for how little product you get

extraits.texte: I would give this zero stars if I could. It feels like small shards of fiberglass are being rubbed into your skin. Made me break out in hives. It's been five days now and I've had hives all over my face and neck.

EDITED: You have to be very careful when this product, the tingling effect irritated my skin pretty badly overtime, and I had to stop using it because I started reacting to all skincare I was using after this one. Burning and eventual flaking of the skin. I think I messed up my skin barrier with daily use of this product, and it probably should only be used similarly to an exfoliator once in a while and not on a daily basis. ———————————- I'm a fan of Korean skin care and pretty much use only things produced by Korean companies. I've heard about this brand, and I've tried a couple of other things from them, which are usually either hit or miss for me. But this sounded promising enough to try. The packaging is good as usual, the box came sealed, there's an expiration date both on the bottle and on the box. The ingredients and descriptions are in both English and Korean, so you don't need to resort to an online translator. I'm not sure why, but my pump started working immediately out of the box, as opposed to usually having to press a bunch of times on new products before they start dispensing anything. I know the box was sealed, but still makes me scratch my head. The serum is of a thicker toner consistency, it's very pink in color, but I know they didn't add anything artificial in terms of coloring, so it must come from some ingredients. There is no smell that I can detect. It does tingle when you apply and rub it, so I'm guessing it's the promised spicules. Not sure how neede

extraits.titre: Helped Tighten My Skin & Minimize Pores
extraits.texte: I’ve loved the Dr. Melaxin Cyano Pink Spicule Serum! The bottle is small, but it lasted me around 6 months since I only use one pump every other night. When I first started using it, I noticed a tingling sensation, but over time my skin adjusted and I barely notice it now. I’ve definitely seen my pores appear smaller and my skin feels tighter and smoother after using it.

The serum is pink, non-sticky, non-oily, non-pilling, and absorbent. It wasn’t so moisturizing but not drying either. My skin felt some softness after applying. No scent. Expect to feel tingles during application. It wasn’t painful. No redness. It was an interesting itchy sensation on the skin. It goes away quickly. On this page it says to avoid rubbing it in and tap/press instead to prevent irritation. The ingredient list seems safe. The micro sized spicules are made from sea sponges. They are used to enhance the absorption of ingredients and revitalize complexion. They’re seen as a natural alternative to microneedling. Since this is exfoliating, I wonder if we could use this daily. This serum reminds me of the viral VT Cosmetics Reedle Shot due to the spicules. The bottle and lid is plastic. The serum came inside the manufacturer's box with a seal. It was made in Korea, expires on 2027/06/17 and is good for 12 months after opening. Right now it’s too soon to tell if it’s doing anything for my skin. I will update my review in the future if necessary. -Ingredients- Water, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Niacinamide, 1,2-Hexanediol, Cetyl Ethylhexanoate, Carbomer, Cetearyl Olivate, Hydroxyacetophenone,Sorbitan Olivate, Tromethamine, Calcium Gluconate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Hydrolyzed Sponge, Adenosine, Cyanocobalamin, Disodium EDTA, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Fruit Extract, TremellaFuciformis (Mushroom) Extract, Tabebuia Impetiginosa Bark Extract, Coffea Arabica (Coffee)
